Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning projects recommended by the public works board.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorization for projects recommended by thepublic works board; amending 2008 c 5 s 1 (uncodified); and declaringan emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: 2008 c 5 s 1 (uncodified) is amended to read as follows:
